overview: The weeks leading up to a young couple's wedding is comic and stressful, especially as their respective fathers try to lay to rest their feud.
tagline: To have and to hold... 'Til dads do us part.

recs.blurb: Two best friends become rivals when their respective weddings are accidentally booked for the same day.
